title: First Solid Food
desc: Sweet potato purée. You stared at it suspiciously, tasted it, made a face, and then opened your mouth for more. A whole new world.
story: We set up the high chair, put on your little bib, and offered you a tiny spoon of sweet potato. You looked at us. You looked at the spoon. You took the most cautious little taste, scrunched your entire face into a ball — and then immediately leaned forward for another bite. Six months of milk and then suddenly: flavour. The expression on your face was priceless.
